title: Final Intensity Hole
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final intensity for the hole as I ~ 4I_0 sin^2(kR^2/4L).

title: Final Intensity Disk
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final intensity for the disk as I' ~ I_0.

title: Use of Fresnel Approximation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the Fresnel approximation for L >> R.

title: Application of Babinet's Principle
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply Babinet's principle to relate the fields from the hole and the disk.

title: Correct Use of Variables
description: Optional Criteria: The student should correctly define and use variables such as k, L, and R throughout the solution.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid sign mistakes in the exponentials when calculating the field contributions.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent, particularly in the context of intensity and wavelength.
